status: Parasol procedural specification and base construction/resized-fit supplement approved for commit on 2026-10-10. No generated models.
source: Supplementary authored outdoor designs, not identified source-image objects.

canopy.method: closed vertically thickened octagonal pyramid shell

ribs.edgeFinish: Intersect each closed finite cylinder with the vertical prism of the canopy octagon and cap the cut. The centreline endpoint stays on the octagon boundary. This prevents a finite-radius tip from protruding beyond the fabric footprint. All eight use the same construction rotated by 45 degrees.

assets.productionMethod: direct programmatic geometry; no Blender intermediary required

parameters.lengthMeaning: Branch length is the centreline distance from the shared pole-top root to a perimeter endpoint, not horizontal radius. All eight branches share this length.

derivation.canopySkeleton: Eight triangles (C,P_i,P_(i+1 mod 8)); connect adjacent endpoints, not just an untriangulated perimeter.
derivation.canopyTop: Translate the skeleton upward by delta; this allows the finite-radius ribs to sit below the fabric, rather than penetrating its upper surface.
derivation.canopyUnderside: Translate canopyTop down by verticalThickness and close perimeter faces; do not add a horizontal bottom disk.
derivation.extents: Derive full local bounds from generated geometry before applying shared whole-unit XYZ scaling. Do not treat the across-vertices span as the X/Y bounding-box width.

parameterValidation: All lengths and radii are finite and positive; 0 <= theta < 90 degrees. Count is fixed at eight and angular pitch at 45 degrees.

Compute delta from the surface-clearance formula; require 0 < (delta-verticalThickness)/sqrt(1+m*m) < ribRadius so every rib intersects the underside without penetrating the top. Reject an invalid combination; do not silently clamp requested lengths or add a support part.
The pole cap is at H. Validate the upper-surface clearance separately from overall dimension tolerance; no metal is allowed outside the canopy top or perimeter.
assets.sourceInterpretation: TOP is flat-sided along X/Y, so start angle is 22.5 degrees. The historical 1.80 m label means opposite-vertex diameter; exact default X/Y extents are 1.662983158520316 m. Source views are not calibrated projections.
assets.constructionStatus: Specification only. Pole length, centreline branch rule, finite-thickness finish and numeric defaults require generated multi-view review before model acceptance.

bore.method: subtract Z cylinder from joined disk/socket solid

assemblyReference.scope: Default dimensions only; independent XYZ resizing requires renewed fit validation.
fitRequirements: Both axis gaps must be positive for centred upright ellipses with aligned axes; otherwise inspect transformed cross-section containment.
Validate generated mesh clearance over the full insertion depth, radial phase and other assembly collisions; the default nominal 1 mm radial gap is not universal after resizing.
Do not use the general dimension tolerance to approve interference; do not auto-resize the bore, pole or either asset to hide incompatible dimensions.

assets.productionMethod: direct programmatic stepped solid with blind bore; Boolean construction or equivalent revolved cross-section; no Blender intermediary required
assets.specificationStatus: User approved the base construction and fit supplement for commit on 2026-10-10. No generated model or implemented fit validation.
constructionOrder: Join disk and socket at Z=0.055; remove internal shared faces and weld the continuous boundary without changing the exterior shoulder.
Subtract the specified blind bore from the joined body. Keep its closed floor at Z=0.015; leave the mouth and passage through Z=0.055 open.
Produce one connected watertight material boundary; no duplicate internal caps, extra bevels, gaps or new parts.
Apply shared overall XYZ scaling to the entire unit, then resolve its independent colour/material override.

sourceInterpretation.authority: The illustration opening proportions differ from the numeric default. Use the specified 37 mm bore, 70 mm socket and 420 mm disk; do not derive dimensions from image pixels. The original drawing is unchanged.

construction.shading: flat canopy faces and cylinder caps; smooth cylinder sides
construction.parts: Parasol: three addressable groups (pole, eight ribs, canopy); finite-thickness joins must stay inside the visible canopy boundary. Base: one connected watertight stepped solid with a blind bore; remove the internal disk/socket interface.
